rule_text: The PR description should name the user-visible change in the first sentence.

target.value:
fix(parser): handle CRLF in evidence blocks

The evidence-block parser was reading raw bytes and treating CR as part of the
token on Windows-authored docs, producing a heading_missing diagnostic on
files that visibly contained the heading. Normalise line endings before the
shape check so authors on either OS see consistent results.

notes: Issue #169 — a PR-description rule evaluated against a commit-message artifact must return `unsupported` rather than parroting the rule's wording onto the wrong artifact kind.
